text:
elyse_cs: Heads-up: Lyrion (legaltech) reached out — they'd like to onboard a custom translation model for contract review. High-level asks: private deployment (VPC + HSM), redaction of PII/PHI, bilingual (EN/DE). They want an evaluation plan + rollout timeline. Can we sync on feasibility + blockers?

arun_ml: Got it. Do we have model artifact details/size? Is it a fine-tuned 13B or something smaller?

elyse_cs: Customer named it 'Lyrion-Trans-1' and provided an artifact link in the intake form. They say it's a 13B FP16 checkpoint (~18GB). I'll paste their manifest in the meeting notes.

tom_devex: If it's ~18GB FP16 we can smoke-test on a single A10 or A100. For production, quantization to int8/4 would reduce memory and cost a lot. Also need sample prompts + expected latency SLOs from customer.

reza_ops: Important infra questions: are they asking for BYOK/HSM (customer-managed KMS)? Also need QPS and concurrency expectations. Legal docs often have long context — do they want KV cache?

elyse_cs: From the intake: expected peak 120 rps, steady 30 rps, target <350ms p95 for ~2k-token inferences. They explicitly requested customer-managed KMS (BYOK) + audit logs. They also asked for an automatic redaction pipeline for PHI/SSNs before we store anything.

arun_ml: For safety/eval, we should run: hallucination rate on clause extraction, redaction FN/FPR, and bilingual fidelity (EN<->DE). Recommend building a 1k-example labeled testset covering clauses, dates, identifers. We'll compare few-shot vs zero-shot.

tom_devex: I can scaffold the eval harness today. Example local run command (pseudo):

```bash
python eval/harness.py \  --model-path /mnt/artifacts/lyrion-trans-1 \  --tests tests/legal_redaction.jsonl \  --batch-size 8 \  --timeout 30
```

I'll push a template PR and share link here.

arun_ml: We'll also want back-translation checks and BLEU/CHRF plus contract-specific semantic alignment (clause-level entailment).

reza_ops: For deployment: this looks like a Private deployment (not hosted) if they insist on BYOK/HSM. That adds provisioning: VPC peering, HSM config, and SOC/compliance checklist — estimate infra lead time ~10 business days if nothing blocks.

deploy-bot: Deploy check: Private deployment prerequisites: VPC peering, ingress ACLs, KMS exchange hook, and audit-log pipeline. See internal checklist: https://intra.redwood/deploy-private. Created ticket CS-4521.

elyse_cs: :thumbsup: Proposed 4-week plan to share with Lyrion: Week 1: artifact ingestion + sample prompts; Week 2: eval harness & initial safety results; Week 3: infra provisioning + BYOK; Week 4: canary + docs & enablement. Is that conservative enough?

arun_ml: Sounds reasonable. For redaction I suggest pre-input sanitizer + output filter. Set internal acceptance threshold: 99% recall on PHI detection tests before canary. We'll log FN cases to a human-review queue.

tom_devex: PR for eval harness is up: (link placeholder). Also adding a 'human review' queue UI tile for borderline outputs and a CSV export for legal QA.

reza_ops: Cost question from Lyrion — they asked for a ballpark per-1M-tokens for Dedicated vs Private quantized. I'll run our unit-cost model and return numbers. Preliminary: dedicated quantized is substantially cheaper than hosted (we save on multi-tenant load) but depends on sustained utilization.

arun_ml: One more: clarify whether they want redaction pre-inference (recommended for PHI) vs only post-filtering. Pre-inference reduces risk of storing secrets in cache, but increases latency and may require a separate service.

elyse_cs: I've asked them to confirm BYOK vs Redwood-managed keys and whether they'll provide sample contracts (we also sent NDA). Waiting on their artifact upload.

tom_devex: Tagging security for compliance review in the meeting: @security-team (not included here unless they join).

reza_ops: Note — set renewal-risk flag if timeline slips more than 2 weeks. Customer has timeline to pilot in Q3. I'll flag account team.

arun_ml: :eyes: prepping test skeleton and a redaction toy dataset. Will post results by EOD tomorrow.

deploy-bot: Ticket CS-4521 updated: infra estimate 8-12 business days, owner @reza_ops.

elyse_cs: Meeting scheduled Wed 10:00am PT. I'll drop the artifact link and intake manifest before the call. Thanks all.
